write_tools.bulk_copy: WRITES: copies a folder tree to another place of the same backend (in /work, or on an opened profile)
write_tools.chmod: WRITES: changes a file's mode (only the bits of 755: no setuid, setgid, sticky, group or world write)
write_tools.copy: WRITES: copies a file or folder on the same backend (an existing target is refused)
write_tools.hardlink: WRITES: makes a hard link (in /work: to a file in /work; on SFTP: the remote's ln)
write_tools.mkdir: WRITES: makes a folder (and its parents)
write_tools.remove: WRITES: deletes a file, link or folder (recursive=true: the whole folder)
write_tools.rename: WRITES: moves or renames a file, link or folder (an existing target is refused)
write_tools.symlink: WRITES: makes a symbolic link (in /work: only to a target inside /work)
write_tools.write_file: WRITES: creates or replaces a whole file (atomically: a temporary file renamed over it)
